answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 29190 Country: India Title: We have named our daughter JASIYA, because it is a short name and less used.Is it a good name? Some people say that its meaning is not good. Please guide us. Question: We have named our daughter JASIYA, because it is a short name and less used.Is it a good name? Some people say that its meaning is not good. Please guide us. Answer ID: 29190 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 209/179/L=1432) Jasiya means: female who rests against knees. As the meaning of Jasiya is not much good, hence it is better to change her name with the names of the holy wives, holy daughters of the Prophet (peace be upon him) or Sahabiyat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
